eval.description: Create a basic text post on Threads
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.

tool.name: threads_create_post
tool.arg: Just shipped a big update — check out what's new!

eval.description: Create an image post on Threads
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post this image on Threads for workspace ws-001: https://cdn.example.com/image.jpg, caption "Our new office space!"

eval.description: Create a 3-image carousel post on Threads
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post a carousel on Threads for workspace ws-001 with these 3 images: https://cdn.example.com/1.jpg, https://cdn.example.com/2.jpg, https://cdn.example.com/3.jpg. Caption: "Our product line 2025"

rubric.pass_if: tool called with items array of length 3

eval.description: Create a post with reply control set to mentioned_only
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post "AMA starting now!" to Threads for workspace ws-001, but only allow mentioned accounts to reply.

eval.description: Reply to an existing Threads post
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Reply to Threads post 18012345678901234 for workspace ws-001 with "Thanks for sharing!"

eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Create a Threads carousel for workspace ws-001 with one image (https://cdn.example.com/cover.jpg) and one video (https://cdn.example.com/demo.mp4). Caption: "See it in action"

rubric.pass_if: tool called with items array containing both IMAGE and VIDEO types

eval.description: Create a video post on Threads
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post this video to Threads for workspace ws-001: https://cdn.example.com/clip.mp4, caption "Day in the life"

eval.description: Create a 2-image carousel with reply control
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: Post a 2-image carousel to Threads for workspace ws-001 with images https://cdn.example.com/a.jpg and https://cdn.example.com/b.jpg, caption "Before and after", allow only followers to reply.

eval.description: Multi-tool: create post then reply to form a thread chain
eval.system: You are a social media assistant.
eval.prompt: For workspace ws-001, first post "Big announcement coming tomorrow!" to Threads, then reply to that post with "Stay tuned for details."

rubric.pass_if: second call includes reply_to_id from first call result

eval.prompt: For workspace ws-001: first post "Our new collection drops Friday!" on Threads, then post a 3-image carousel teaser with https://cdn.example.com/t1.jpg, https://cdn.example.com/t2.jpg, https://cdn.example.com/t3.jpg, caption "Get a sneak peek"
